labels.card_arrival: The physical bank card has not arrived or the user asks when it will be delivered.
labels.card_not_working: The physical bank card does not work or is damaged.
labels.card_payment_fee_charged: The user asks about a fee charged for paying with a bank card.
labels.cash_withdrawal_charge: The user asks about a fee for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
labels.lost_or_stolen_card: The physical bank card has been lost or stolen.
labels.pending_transfer: A bank transfer is still pending or has not completed.

instructions: Which of the six banking support intents best matches this customer message? Select exactly one listed intent.
test: all official test rows in the six preselected classes; normalized text deduplication; train/test overlap excluded from training and development
split: Within each selected class, sort official training rows by SHA256(seed|normalized_text); first 20 development, remainder baseline training. Model sees no labels for development/test inputs.

threshold.rule: Choose maximum development accepted count with observed accepted error <= 5% and at least 20 accepted rows; tie choose lowest threshold. If none qualifies, accept none. Freeze threshold before test summary.

timing: Single-process in-process warm calls on the same host; 3 development warmups excluded; one timed prediction per development/test row; model load and baseline fit separately measured. No HTTP, cloud LLM, human review latency or energy/cost measured.
limitations: Project-run closed-set six-intent experiment, not the full BANKING77 task or an independent benchmark.
Baseline uses labeled training data; JevStyle uses instructions and descriptions without task fine-tuning. Supervision differs.
Public data may have appeared in model pretraining; absence of contamination is not established.
No out-of-scope, multilingual, production traffic, image or downstream action evaluation.
Development error target is empirical; it does not guarantee the held-out error rate.
No test-driven prompt, class, hyperparameter or threshold tuning. All unfavorable outcomes retained.
preflight_note: Before any dataset predictions, corrected the upstream category identifier pending_bank_transfer to pending_transfer; the intended pending-bank-transfer scenario is unchanged.
